recipe.name: 10-Minute Outage Brief
recipe.title: CITYWIDE OUTAGE · 10-MIN BRIEF
recipe.body:
Objective: protect life safety, stabilize the grid, and publish one trusted operating picture.
0–2 min: status · 2–6 min: blockers · 6–10 min: decisions.

recipe.name: Role · Incident Commander
recipe.title: ROLE · INCIDENT COMMANDER
recipe.body:
Owns priorities and cross-agency tradeoffs.
Now: confirm life-safety objective and operational period.

recipe.name: Role · Grid Operations
recipe.title: ROLE · GRID OPERATIONS
recipe.body:
Owns isolation, switching, crews, and restoration estimates.
Report: affected substations and next safe action.

recipe.name: Role · Public Information
recipe.title: ROLE · PUBLIC INFORMATION
recipe.body:
Owns public guidance and rumor control.
Report: approved message, channels, and next update time.

recipe.name: Active · Grid Instability
recipe.title: ACTIVE · GRID INSTABILITY
recipe.body:
Unknown fault boundary; restoration estimate not yet defensible.
Need: isolate fault and validate switching path.

recipe.name: Active · Critical Facilities
recipe.title: ACTIVE · CRITICAL FACILITIES
recipe.body:
Hospitals, water pumping, transit, and shelters are on mixed backup power.
Need: rank sites by endurance and consequence.

recipe.name: Decision · Restoration Priority
recipe.title: DECISION DUE · RESTORATION PRIORITY
recipe.body:
Choose the first restoration corridor.
Due: minute 6 · Owner: Incident Commander · Inputs: safe path + facility endurance.

recipe.name: Decision · Public Advisory
recipe.title: DECISION DUE · PUBLIC ADVISORY
recipe.body:
Approve duration language, safety actions, and next update time.
Due: minute 8 · Owner: Incident Commander · Publisher: Public Information.
